	monthly_progress = {
		add = { desc = "DIPLOREASON_BASE" value = 0.06 }
		add = {
			desc = "[ShowModifierTypeName('monthly_nahualt_reform_progress')]"
			value = modifier:monthly_nahualt_reform_progress
		}
		add = {
			desc = "[crown_power|e]"
			value = "estate_power(estate_type:crown_estate)"
			multiply = 0.12
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = ruler_or_regent }
			add = {
				desc = "ruler_or_regent_total_abilities"
				value = ruler_or_regent.total_abilities
				multiply = 0.0015
			}
		}
	}
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no

		religion = religion:nahuatl
	}
	allow = {
		OR = {
			owns = location:tenochtitlan

			owns = location:tlacopan
			num_locations >= 4
		}
	}
	modifier_while_progressing = {
		global_construction_speed = -0.05
	}
	modifier_on_completion = {
		global_monthly_food_modifier = 0.15
		global_food_capacity_modifier = 0.25
		global_population_growth = 0.0015
		monthly_doom = -0.05
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = 2 }
}
